package.name: wpb_service_robot
package.description: Competition total task for the WPB Home service robot: enroll multiple owners (name + face + body via voice), then search for each of them and recognise what they are doing. Modules that are not finished yet (navigation / electrical switch / fall assist / exit) are kept as explicit placeholder interfaces in task_all_owners.py so they can be filled in later without touching the main flow.
